name: package-manager
description: Holds Claude to the project's package manager and wrapper, giving the exact command to run instead, and stops it weakening the supply-chain guards of pnpm, npm, yarn, bun and uv: release-age gates, install scripts and overrides, plus global installs and hand-edited lockfiles.

fallback.title: Without a lockfile
fallback.description: Managers to hold to when a project names none, one per ecosystem, comma-separated, like `pnpm, uv`. Empty holds to nothing.
